title: A textbook table lists telling real from pretend at age 5
summary: OpenStax's milestone table lists, at age 5, telling real from pretend.
body: Table 9.4's age-5 personal and social cell includes telling real from pretend, and liking to please friends. The contrast is the child's sorting of play from the actual world, in a textbook row. It is not the CDC 4-year line about pretending to be someone else, and it is not a percent. The table is a summary for teaching. A child who still blends play and reality at 5 is not labeled by this card.
